Core: a box {r<eps1, |t-t0|<eps2} inside U, in log-polar coordinates a convex angle-shift-invariant B ⊆ C×R; (1) lift f|reg through the covering {r>0} -> reg E0 (mathlib IsCoveringMapOn.existsUnique_continuousMap_lifts, GX isCoveringMapOn_orbitMk_cylPos); (2) Liouville exists_smul_eq_on_of_isLocalHomeomorphOn: D∘f~ = g∘D; (3) one turn is a deck shift k, uniqueness of lifts, so gP = P^k g by rigidity of Isom(M3); (4) null coordinates: g preserves the fixed line Ru of P^k, is axis-preserving (GX.IsAxisAff: b(Lw)=b(w)/lam, lam>0), D^-1 g D is an explicit homeomorphism of the cylinder (GX.btzConj, GX.IsAxisAff.homeo; r -> r/lam, t -> (1/lam-lam) r + lam t + s0); (5) injectivity forces k = ±1 by the intermediate value theorem on the angle along one circle (GX.btzConj_winding, GX.e0BoxSec_orbit_ne); (6) descent to Aut(E0) (GX.btzE0Descend) and membership in G (GX.e0Lift_mem). k = -1 (theta -> -theta) is not excluded and need not be. The field's connectedness of U and 0 ≤ alpha0 are carried; the local core uses neither.

Lifting through the BTZ covering: GX.isCoveringMapOn_orbitMk_cylPos + mathlib IsCoveringMapOn.existsUnique_continuousMap_lifts on a convex box in log-polar coordinates (GX.e0BoxSec, GX.e0Box; Convex.contractibleSpace, IsOpen.locPathConnectedSpace) — no abstract universal cover needed.

An isometry g with gP = P^k g (k ≠ 0) is, in null coordinates, axis-preserving (GX.IsAxisAff), and D^-1 g D is an explicit homeomorphism of the cylinder (GX.btzConj): r -> r/lam, t -> (1/lam - lam) r + lam t + s0 — continuity at the axis needs only r and t, never theta (the natural topology of DInfty at the apex is {r < eps}).
B21 prop:isom_strong's 'injectivity forces l = 1' is the intermediate value theorem on the angle along one circle (GX.btzConj_winding): no invariance of domain, no normaliser classification.
